name: Settings Manager
author: Uwe Bruckhaus
description: Manage Omarchy shell plugins and zero-privilege Hyprland/Omarchy desktop settings in one window: Plugins, Bar layout with drag and drop, Updates, Network, Bluetooth, Appearance, Displays, Sound, Power, Input devices, Applications, About, and Settings. Features a reorderable sidebar with custom separators and responsive layout; never asks for administrator rights.
